what: the harvest failed 27 times when stars landed while it worked: its guard - rebase and retry - needed a name to sign with, given only to the first commit, so the guard crashed on the very event it was for
countermeasure: the name set for the repository, so a rebase signs too; proven by its own event - a collision staged on the lab against a throwaway repository: the old step fails as it did, the new one rebases and lands both
